manifest.name: teammate-squad
manifest.description: One agent squad of one space (backlog:0d2d8f2e): a named team with an objective and a metric, member agents with roles, phases with an approval mode, sources with a time, outputs and a monthly spending cap. Created from a template or from a free-text brief; every row is managed. (backlog:0d2d8f2e)

migrations.name: create_teammate_squads
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teammate_squads (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  objective TEXT,
  metric_name TEXT,
  metric_target INTEGER,
  metric_unit TEXT,
  members_json TEXT,
  phases_json TEXT,
  sources_json TEXT,
  outputs_json TEXT,
  spending_cap_cents INTEGER,
  template_slug TEXT,
  brief TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('active', 'paused')),
  decided_at TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  source_package TEXT,
  source_action TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_squads_space_id ON teammate_squads(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_squads_source_package ON teammate_squads(source_package);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_teammate_squads
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."teammate_squads" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT,
  "objective" TEXT,
  "metric_name" TEXT,
  "metric_target" BIGINT,
  "metric_unit" TEXT,
  "members_json" TEXT,
  "phases_json" TEXT,
  "sources_json" TEXT,
  "outputs_json" TEXT,
  "spending_cap_cents" BIGINT,
  "template_slug" TEXT,
  "brief" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'paused')),
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "source_package" TEXT,
  "source_action" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "teammate_squads_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_squads"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "teammate_squads_source_package"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_squads"("source_package");
